image.scope: Only files you select are accessible. Keep up to 100 images, each at most 50 MiB. Zoom and rotation affect the preview; saving copies the original file.
image.permission: Image access needs files:pick permission from the App Store.
image.revoked: Some saved files are no longer shared. Select them again to restore access.
image.openHint: Choose JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP, AVIF, BMP, ICO or SVG images through EveryOS. Actual decoding depends on your browser.
image.panHint: Drag to pan, or focus the preview and use Alt + arrow keys. Zoom is relative to the fitted image.
image.unsupported: This image cannot be decoded, exceeds the 80-megapixel preview limit or is not supported by this browser. Try another format.
image.metadataFailed: EXIF metadata could not be read. File details and the preview remain available.

app.name: Image Viewer
app.description: View selected images with zoom, rotation, metadata and a slideshow.
